page_title: AUG 1-0 HAM | Augsburg v Hamburger SV 22/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Hamburger SV failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+2' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
90+1' The ball is cleared after Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
88' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
87' Immanuel Pherai (Hamburger) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
86' Substitution. Guilherme Ramos (Hamburger) in, Nicolas Capaldo out.
86' Here is a change. Albert Sambi Lokonga is going off and Merlin Polzin gives the last tactical orders to Immanuel Pherai (Hamburger).
85' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
85' Some great controlled play and passing from Augsburg. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
83' We are about to witness a substitution. Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) is replacing Fabian Rieder.
82' Merlin Polzin prepares a substitution. Giorgi Gocholeishvili is replaced by Alexander Rossing-Lelesiit (Hamburger).
82' Substitution. Jordan Torunarigha will be replaced by Robert Glatzel (Hamburger).
81' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
80' A lofted cross from Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
79' Hamburger SV enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
76' 1 - 0 What a hit! Anton Kade (Augsburg) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the middle of the net. 1:0.

76' A neat pass is well received by Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
73' Sandro Wagner decides to make a substitution. Han-Noah Massengo will be replaced by Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg).
72' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Robin Braun blows his whistle for a foul.
72' Substitution. Fabio Vieira walks off the pitch and Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) comes on as a substitute.
71' The attendance is 30660.
71' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
66' Augsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
64' Sandro Wagner has decided to substitute Alexis Claude-Maurice and he is replaced by Elias Saad (Augsburg).
64' It will be a substitution. Samuel Essende (Augsburg) is ready to enter the pitch as Mert Komur walks off.
64' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
63' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Finn Dahmen has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
61' This is a yellow card! Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
61' The referee blows his whistle as Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) was too aggressive in his challenge.
60' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
57' An attempted cross from Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) is cleared.
56' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) commits a rough foul. Robin Braun stops the game and makes a call.
54' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

52' Great solo effort by Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the roof of the net. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.
51' 49:51 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
51' The Augsburg players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.

49' A big opportunity is wasted by Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Finn Dahmen pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
48' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
47' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Robin Braun blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Hamburger SV comes to nothing.

45+2' Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) serves up a nice cross, but Finn Dahmen punches the ball away.
44' The corner is swung in but Hamburger SV can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

43' Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Finn Dahmen was alert and the score remains the same.
42' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
41' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
39' Augsburg couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Daniel Heuer Fernandes (Hamburger) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
38' Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robin Braun had an easy-decision to make.
37' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes comes off his line to gather the ball.
36' The game is interrupted as Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) is flagged offside.
36' The Hamburger SV players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
34' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) was quite harsh and Robin Braun didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
33' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Daniel Heuer Fernandes, who smothers the ball.
31' The free kick from long range, taken by Augsburg, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
31' A clumsy foul by Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) and Robin Braun blows his whistle.
30' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
29' Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) commits a rough challenge and Robin Braun blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
25' Robin Braun interrupts the game. One of the players from Hamburger SV won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
24' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.
23' Augsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

23' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the roof of the net, but is thwarted by a great save from Daniel Heuer Fernandes.
21' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
20' Mert Komur (Augsburg) unleashes a close-range volley low towards the middle of the goal, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains unchanged.
18' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 2:0.
17' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
16' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
15' Robin Braun blows his whistle and signals a foul after Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) brought his opponent down.
14' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
14' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Hamburger SV.
11' A long-range effort by Miro Muheim (Hamburger) after he received a good pass was well wide of the right post.
10' Robin Braun blows his whistle after Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
10' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
8' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
8' One of the players from Augsburg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Augsburg.

5' Anton Kade (Augsburg) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Daniel Heuer Fernandes anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
5' The Augsburg players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
3' Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
3' Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
2' The resulting set piece from Augsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
